title: Hyperelliptic Phase 9 acceptance
objective: Provide a source-authenticated bounded Phase 9 analytic acceptance harness and receipt contract covering true fresh initialization versus resident PARI, warm versus fresh evaluation, genus-2/3 derivative speedups, cold universal-table amortization, direct Arb differentials, and exact/refined CPU family scans.

handoff.summary: Confirmed that no durable final Phase-9 receipt existed: the only checked analytic JSON is the historical before-baseline with null commit/date and no Phase-9 gates. Added a source-authenticated, transactional, bounded acceptance harness. It brackets Sage.js with matched-64-bit resident PARI, gates only true isolated fresh plan misses, separates cache hits and one explicitly cold universal-table observation, retains direct one/four-worker Arb evidence, and proves exact twist coefficient/sign digests plus sequential/two-worker CPU refinement. A full source-current one-sample local diagnostic passed in 204.920 seconds: fresh init was 1.613x PARI, warm/fresh 232.946x, minimum genus-2/genus-3 derivative speedups were 31.657x/937.855x, direct genus-2/genus-3 scaled differences were 4.19e-14/4.47e-7 inside declared tolerances, and all ten family rows passed exact/refinement gates.
risks: No acceptance receipt is fabricated or checked in by this lane: bench-1 remained reserved and untouched. The local receipt uses Node 26, one sample, and a busy development host and is explicitly diagnostic-only.

The five-sample acceptance is projected at 15--19 minutes from a measured 3m10.7s one-sample competitive route plus 20--80 seconds of exact evidence. The runner enforces a hard 20-minute total deadline; an honestly failed receipt may require increasing the documented bound and rerunning, never relabeling partial evidence.

The embedded legacy competitive JSON still contains its historical mixed cold/warm row when samples exceed one. The acceptance gate deliberately ignores that field and uses the new single explicitly cleared cache-miss observation with exact coefficients prewarmed.

Integration must add the new focused test to shared manifest ownership if repository-wide manifest enforcement requires it, then rebuild on bench-1 so the build receipt covers the integrated commit and pinned Node 22.22.2 native artifacts.
next_steps: Cherry-pick this lane, reserve an idle bench-1, build the exact clean integrated commit with Node 22.22.2, and run the command in analytic-acceptance/README.md with SAGEJS_BENCH_HOST=bench-1.

Commit the transactionally written phase9-receipt-linux-x64.json even if a numerical gate fails, validate it source-current, and update the completion audit from EVIDENCE AUDIT only when every gate passes.
Preserve the separate process-cold construction and cache-hit rows in future benchmark refactors; never compare a Sage.js prefix/same-L cache hit with a fresh PARI lfuninit.
